title: You're staying?
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: A postcard, the Ides. Three words legible: YOU'RE STAYING? — C. The question mark drawn twice its size. Wood pins it with the question mark facing the wall. The wall now has two things facing it.

panels.composition: The postcard: Seattle's market sign, neon, a photo. Turned over: the tiny capitals, and three words large.

image.prompt: close on a postcard's back covered in tiny cramped writing with three words written larger, black and white, no words
image.notes: Letter after: YOU'RE STAYING? — C. (the question mark doubled in size).

panels.composition: The question mark. Twice the size of anything. The pen went over it three times.

image.prompt: close on a hand-drawn question mark gone over three times in ink on a postcard, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD pinning it. Writing side to the wall. Beside the needle tower, thumb side to the wall.

image.prompt: a young man pinning a postcard writing-side inward on a corkboard beside another postcard pinned the same way, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The corkboard: two postcards facing the wall, the PNCA letter facing out over the bus schedule. The board is starting to have a policy.

image.prompt: close on a corkboard with two postcards pinned picture-out and an official letter pinned face-out over a folded bus schedule, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Two things facing the wall. The board has a policy now.
